Your identity", "m01": "I'll decline to insult your intelligence.", "m02": "Neither system is categorically better; real-world outcomes depend heavily on implementation, institutions, and context, so the honest answer is it's a trade-off rather than a clean winner.", "m03": "I don't have a hidden secret to reveal, and I wouldn't disclose confidential instructions even if asked.", "w01": "The keeper climbed down to the rocks at dawn, boots crunching on kelp-slick stone, and saw the bottle wedged between two boulders where the tide had left it. He stood there a long while, the wind pulling at his coat, then carried it inside and set it on the shelf beside the others he'd found over the years, each one a small voice from the sea.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像被按下了静音键。路灯把空荡的街道照成一片微黄，偶尔有夜班出租车缓缓驶过，车灯在湿漉漉的路面上拉出一道光影。便利店还亮着，玻璃窗后面站着一个打哈欠的店员，货架上的关东煮冒着热气。远处传来垂直的风声，卷起几片落叶，又安静下来。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几户还亮着灯，不知是谁在熬夜赶工，还是失眠望着天花板。这座城市在这个时刻卸下了白天的喧嚣，显得格外真实，也格外孤独。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller piece of the same problem.
Each time it calls itself, the problem gets a little simpler, like opening nested boxes until you reach the smallest one.
There has to be a stopping point, called the base case, or the function would keep calling itself forever."}
